extracted.intended_audience: beat reporters, sports media, and credentialed press covering NBA teams/venues
extracted.subtask_description: A media/press guide for credentialed reporters covering NBA teams (venue directions, media entrances, parking, will-call, and team PR contacts). Includes procedural guidance for accessing venues and contacting team/media-relations staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media entrance location and opening times
rubrics_metrics.description: MEDIA ENTRANCE: Located at the Google Entrance on the south side of Little Caesars Arena, near Cass Ave. and Fisher Freeway. The press door opens two-and-a-half hours prior to tip-off. Media Will Call opens three hours prior to tip-off.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document lists specific media entrance locations for each venue (e.g., Google Entrance at Little Caesars Arena; primary media entrance next to Administrative Entrance on LaBranch Street at Toyota Center; 730 Terry Francois Boulevard at Chase Center). It repeatedly states opening times (press door opens 2½ hours prior to tip-off; Media Will Call opens three hours prior), and notes doors will be marked for media and gated off from the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media parking availability and parking-pass procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: MEDIA PARKING: Parking is provided for media members in the Toyota Tundra Garage through Entry #5 located at the corner of Jackson and Leeland or Entry #3 located on Leeland. All media members needing parking must request a parking pass from the Media Relations Department.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Venues list specific media parking garages/locations (e.g., UWM Parking Garage, Toyota Tundra Garage). Several teams note limited parking (e.g., 'Parking at Chase Center is extremely limited. Please contact Warriors PR for availability.') and require media to request a parking pass from Media Relations. The guide instructs that parking pass requests should be submitted along with credential requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Will Call policy (tickets vs. credentials and timing)
rubrics_metrics.description: WILL CALL (TICKETS ONLY, NO PRESS CREDENTIALS): Located on the west side of Toyota Center near the main entrance on LaBranch Street. MEDIA WILL CALL opens three hours prior to tip-off.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Will Call is explicitly for tickets only and not for press credentials at some venues; media should not expect to obtain credentials at Will Call. Opening times for Will Call are provided (commonly three hours prior to tip-off).

rubrics_metrics.name: Directions to venue from airports and major routes
rubrics_metrics.description: DIRECTIONS TO: LITTLE CAESARS ARENA FROM METRO AIRPORT: Exit airport going North on Merriman Road, to I-94 East toward Detroit. Take exit 215A to merge onto MI-10 South toward Downtown... (full step-by-step driving directions provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide provides step-by-step driving directions from local airports (multiple examples across teams) and from other key approaches. Use these route instructions for planning arrival times and selecting media entrances/parking entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public transit guidance and special transit notes
rubrics_metrics.description: PUBLIC TRANSIT TO CHASE CENTER: BART: Transfer at either Powell Street Station or 16th St. Mission Station. From Powell Street Station: Transfer to the Union Square/Market St Muni Station... you will not be able to scan your ticket to enter the turnstile. Please use the elevators or show your event ticket to the agent to access the system for free.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide recommends public transportation or rideshare at venues with limited parking. It includes specific transit transfer instructions (BART, Caltrain, Muni) and operational notes (e.g., inability to scan tickets at certain stations; show event ticket to agent).

rubrics_metrics.name: Credential and parking-pass submission requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All media members needing parking must request a parking pass from the Media Relations Department. Please submit that request along with your credential request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide ties parking-pass requests to the credentialing process: media should bundle parking-pass requests with credential applications to Media Relations. This is presented as the required procedure to obtain parking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media website access requires PR contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Media Website: www.hoopsomg.com (contact Pistons PR for access).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certain team or venue media websites require PR contact to obtain access. The guide directs media to contact the listed Pistons PR (or equivalent) to gain access to team media web resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media entrance security and physical access control
rubrics_metrics.description: The doors will be marked for media and gated off from the public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Venues emphasize that media entrances are physically separated from public entry (gated/marked). Expect restricted access points for media, and follow signage and directions from venue staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team media relations contact directory for press inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists PR/communications staff by name, title, phone (office/cell) and email for each team (examples: Kevin Grigg, Executive Vice President & Chief Communications Officer, kgrigg@pistons.com; Tracey Hughes, Vice President of Media & Player Relations, traceyh@rocketball.com).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided names, phone numbers, and emails for credential requests, interview coordination, media parking, website access, and other press inquiries. Multiple team staff and departmental contacts (PR, communications, game-night offices) are provided for each club.
